content_html:
Watched #Brahmastra : Personally I loved the movie….it had Good Content + Great Visualisation (from Directors perspective) + Great Star Cast + Excellent Acting

Poor Graphics is the only minus in this movie which other wise would had been a GREAT WATCH!!!

The only thing I couldn’t understand was the concept of Hero getting Fire ignited when Heroine is around!!! Vaadu em fire gurunchi matladuthunado 😉

I watched the 9:30 show and when I read reviews post movie I was shocked to see all the reviews being complete opposite to what I have experienced while watching movie. They say the Graphics were Great but the content was let down 🤷🏻‍♂️ For a minute I thought was I different from the lot and had to take time to introspect my movie watching experience but still I felt the same, It had very good content for the type if story they selected and have the potential of a Franchise based film similar to Krish. I had to crosscheck with my friend who watched it along with me and he also had similar opinion to mine.

Finally I conclude that this movie caters to different audience in different ways and you must watch it to have your own experience. I would be definitely watching it for the second time for my daughter. Kids will love it.

PS : No-onefrom cini industry cares that I exist hence there is no point in them bribing me to give positive review. So consider this as my genuine experience and it may differ from yours based on our tastes 😉
